Daily Devotional

March 25

7 But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart. (1 Samuel 16:7 KJV)

This verse tells us a tremendous truth about how God looks at us. Where as man looks at the outer appearance of others the Lord looks at our hearts, because He is a Spirit (John 4:24). This means that the motives we have in our hearts are more important to God than the actions we have. This fact causes fear in some, as they would rather be judged by their actions than motives. It should bring peace and comfort to the Christian, as we have been given a brand new heart when we are born again. Our spirit is now as righteous and holy (Ephesians 4:24) as Jesus’ is (1 John 4:17). When God looks upon a born again Christian He sees us as perfect as Jesus is, because He sees His Son’s Spirit (Galatians 4:6). Praise God.

The above scripture was when Samuel the prophet was sent by God to anoint David the new King of Israel, and the first sons brought to Samuel were passed over by God, as He was looking for a man after His own heart (1 Samuel 13:14), who was David. Thank you Lord for giving us your righteousness through Jesus, so that we appear righteous to you. Thank you Jesus, for giving us your righteousness – Praise God.
